name: Firebox Bot
description: A powerful, multi-functional WhatsApp automation bot designed to elevate the general chat experience with smart tools and utilities.

SESSION_ID.description: Your unique bot session ID (starts with FIREBOX~).

SUDO.description: The Super-Admin phone number with country code (e.g. 254769564723). Can run system commands.

OWNERS.description: Additional admin phone numbers, separated by commas (e.g., 254711111111,254722222222).

MONGODB_URI.description: MongoDB connection string (e.g. mongodb+srv://...). Falls back to local JSON store if not set.
